description: This file defines the interface AesStreamInterfaceV2 in the Aws\Crypto namespace, outlining methods related to AES encryption details such as obtaining the AES name, OpenSSL identifier, and Initialization Vector (IV).

classes.name: AesStreamInterfaceV2
classes.description: Interface for AES stream encryption, extending the StreamInterface, providing methods to get AES encryption parameters.

methods.name: getStaticAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES recognizable name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'. The interface is accessible from a static context.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an identifier recognizable by `openssl_*` functions, such as 'aes-256-cbc' or 'aes-128-ctr'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the IV (Initialization Vector) that should be used to initialize the next block in encrypt or decrypt.
